title: Pregnant Solo #48
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Nigerian woman, an adult, in her early 50s, cool and composed expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — and between them, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward, her waistline already soft and gently defined even without the pregnancy, now continuing that same soft fullness into the belly's round curve with no harsh transition anywhere. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter glowing on the cheekbones, bold shimmering gold and emerald eyeshadow blended out toward the temples, dramatic long lashes, sharply defined brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong glossy fuchsia-pink lip, long braids piled into a high sculpted crown, a bright, joyful smile, sleek straight hair, real pores, real living eyes, 5 drop dangles piercings set with rubies in bronze-toned metal, wearing a single piece of mixed-metal a bracelet. Full body painted in Russian Palekh miniature lacquer, a deep black ground with fine gold linework and firebirds, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the pattern reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps, wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of jewel-toned scenework wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's natural centrepiece, the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip and the other beneath her belly's curve, composed radiant expression, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme gold extreme platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
